svg.title: Widening what AI determines
svg.desc: What moves is how much of the path AI determines: from drafting steps a human approves, through executing a plan agreed up front, to planning within stated constraints. What does not move is who owns the objective, the constraints and the outcome. How far it widens is decided by results rather than confidence, blast radius overrides track record, and it is granted per context rather than globally.
svg.text: WHAT MOVES IS HOW MUCH OF THE PATH AI DETERMINES

g.text: AI proposes each step and a human
The plan is settled up front, then AI
carries it out and reports back.
The human states the objective and
what counts as success. AI works out
the path from the current context.

svg.text: What does not move: who owns the objective, the constraints, and the outcome
WHAT DECIDES HOW FAR IT WIDENS
Results decide, rather than confidence. Widen where outcomes of that kind have repeatedly held up, and narrow the moment they stop.
Blast radius overrides track record. Where a mistake is hard to reverse, approval stays. It is granted per context, rather than globally.
